title: Hiyori per-entry document
description: One anime or manga entry as written by the relational publish pipeline to data/<kind>/<hiyori_id>-<slug>.json and returned by GET /api/entries/{id}.

hiyori_id.description: Stable, global, immutable id shared by anime and manga. Allocated once by migration v3 (allocate_hiyori_ids) / `php hiyori hiyori-id --backfill`, recorded in the _hiyori_ids registry.

slug.description: URL-safe, deterministic slug of title. Unique within a kind (unique index kind+slug).

titles.description: Normalized title variants; `default` is the display title, `romaji`/`english`/`native` are variants when known.

type.description: Source format/type, e.g. TV, movie, OVA, manga, novel.

status.description: Release status, e.g. finished, publishing, not_yet_published, on_hiatus, discontinued.

season.description: Anime premiere season, e.g. spring/summer/fall/winter (anime only).

references.description: Source shorthand -> source id. Anime uses al/mal/k; manga uses al_manga/mal_manga/k_manga. Empty object when the entry carries no cross-references.

legacy_id.description: Pre-hiyori_id identifier (the old _id / source id) kept for traceability and id recovery.
